input_provenance.copy_changes: Remove production test-module include; add benchmark-only serial-denominator/two-pass and fused-row drivers. Original execution functions unchanged.

protocol.data: Same 16 real Eiger9M frames distributed across 625-frame HDF5 file, mapped as immutable bottom-up f64; same original unscreened float64 CSR coefficients for all runtime-mask backends; CSC bit-preserving transpose.
protocol.settings: 2000 uniform 2theta degree bins, full pixel splitting, solid-angle normalization, polarization 0.965; identical pixel corrections in all kernels.
protocol.masks: Upper intensity threshold, OR existing static mask. Fixed thresholds 323, 230, 207 chosen from approximately 99.9th, 99th, 95th pooled sampled percentiles of static-valid real frame pixels (stride97). Masks change because images change; wraparound also verified. Actual per-frame counts recorded.
protocol.timed_mask_update: Native fused threshold and static OR pass allocating combined u8 mask, plus explicit clone for backend ownership; allocate/drop every frame, no precomputed masks in timed runs. Does not time Python/NumPy plugin calls, UI events or expensive cosmic/powder-outlier mask algorithms.
protocol.baseline: Recompute current production denominator serially per frame, then current parallel CSR signal/variance rows. Benchmark driver bypasses shared mutable denominator cache to support independent concurrent frame masks. Verified byte-identical to actual copied production invalidate_normalization+integrate on every frame/error/threshold. No reused denominators.
protocol.fused_csr: Same production row, signal/denominator/Poisson variance fused in one parallel bin traversal, dynamic mask check at each sparse contribution.
protocol.csc: One mask check per pixel; f64 signal, denominator and variance accumulated simultaneously in one or four interleaved histograms. No table rebuild per frame.
protocol.recompact: Diagnostic rebuilds a compacted CSR execution table each frame from original coefficients, preserving remaining weight bits. Includes allocation, index conversion, denominator recomputation and integration; geometry weights reused. Sequential filtering prototype, not an optimized compactor.
protocol.timing: Five >=1s warmed blocks per backend/error/threshold, rotate/reverse backend order; one warm batch before each block; includes mask construction/copy/drop, per-frame normalization, axes, normalized result allocation and errors. No geometry/CSC setup, frame decoding or HDF5 IO in throughput timing.
protocol.threads: Independent 16-frame batches at 8 threads for all three thresholds; 1 and4 for threshold230. CSR additionally parallelizes bins. CSC parallelizes frames. Recompaction timed at8 only.
protocol.numeric_checks: Every threshold/frame/error checked vs actual current CSR including real cache invalidation. Strict one-histogram CSC and strict CSR asserted bit-identical. Tiny FMA/summation-order differences allowed in fast kernels, no float32.
protocol.host_load: Other-process CPU seconds sampled at block boundaries; all raw measurements retained. No user workloads stopped.
protocol.limits: Native warmed batch throughput; no Python bridge or HDF5 IO/decompression, cold-cache, one-image latency, arbitrary masking algorithm or GPU measurements.
protocol.api_limits: Native kernel and mask generation/copy benchmark. Python/NumPy dispatch, set_mask API calls and cache-lock bookkeeping excluded. Cache invalidation is represented by fully recomputing the denominator each frame, with no cached reuse.

protocol.fixed: Published0.7.0 versus local dev wheel with same NumPy2.4.2, 16 readonly float64 Eiger9M frames, 2000 full-pixel-split bins, solid-angle/polarization0.965 and same static mask. Batch API8workers/1thread, shared integrator/LUT. Five >=1s warm blocks; includes result materialization. Fixed masks set once, setup excluded.
protocol.dynamic: Published0.7.0 versus local dynamic mode, same NumPy threshold230 masks recreated each frame and set_mask plus normalization/integration. Eight processes each1Rayon thread; initializer barrier ensures all8LUT/CSC preparations finish before timing. Five >=1s blocks per error mode. Includes API output materialization and inter-process result transfer. Sources/reproduction scripts included.
protocol.preliminary: Earlier short-batch new dynamic API samples are retained with preliminary- prefix but are not used for conclusions. The final old/new dynamic controls use a startup barrier and >=1s blocks to exclude worker startup and reduce sampling noise.
protocol.limits: Warm compute-only frames; no HDF5 IO/decompression or mask-detection algorithms beyond threshold. One M4 Pro machine, normal concurrent host activity. Float64 in both old/new Dioptrin. No package publication or Dioptas changes.
